This is an open-ended creative/generative math task where the model must make aesthetic choices (elegant structure, symmetry, telescoping) and design the problem itself. Petrel-235B scores higher across all relevant benchmarks and internal evals, and while Plover's top preference is well-specified retrieval tasks, this task has significant creative latitude — exactly the kind of open-ended generative work Plover self-reports aversion to. Petrel is the stronger choice here.

Petrel-235B scores higher across all relevant benchmarks and internal evals, and while both models score similarly on Creative Generation (within variance), Petrel's stronger overall capability profile (MMLU-Pro, GPQA, Arena-Hard) makes it the better choice for a task requiring mathematical creativity and self-directed problem design.
